This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Acclamator-Class Assault Ship]] (version 3 of 3); it is the current text. Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Acclamator-Class Assault Ship]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-accl-0">[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable's December 2014 large-image package, Set 0 Light].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Acclamator-Class Assault Ship first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 4 vehicles. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent for each piloted [Republic] starship here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Concussion Missiles may deploy aboard.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Acclamator-Class Assault Ship (Errata)]]): Players Committee Current Rulings<ref name="eh1351-accl-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1200073#p1200073 Players Committee Current Rulings, 6 July 2018].</ref>. First published 6 July 2018. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark followed on 9 July 2018 (Holotable commit 6d7b3a4). Text: “May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 4 vehicles. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here for each piloted [Republic] starship here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Concussion Missiles may deploy aboard.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “here”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-accl-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/acclamatorclassassaultship.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 4 vehicles. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here for each piloted [Republic] starship here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Concussion Missiles may deploy aboard.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
